overview: The Medford School Committee received updates on the Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility, Medford Vocational Technical High School, and district professional development. The committee also recognized student winners in SkillsUSA and DECA competitions, approved out-of-state field trips, and accepted an anonymous donation for the high school ethics team.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: The committee approved the minutes from the March 18, 2019 meeting.

items.title: Approval of Bills, Transfer of Funds, and Payroll
items.summary: The committee voted to table the approval of bills and payroll so members could review printed copies.

items.title: Community Participation and Ethics Team Donation
items.summary: Member DiBenedetto requested future agenda discussions regarding gymnastics facility closures, field permitting, and bus traffic, after which the committee suspended rules to accept a $300 donation for the high school ethics team.

items.title: Superintendent's Update and Announcements
items.summary: Associate Superintendent Caldwell delivered district announcements, including student achievements, upcoming middle school lottery dates, and community events.

items.title: Center for Citizenship and Social Responsibility Update
items.summary: Staff and student representatives presented an overview of districtwide student leadership initiatives and community service projects, and the committee accepted the report.

items.title: SkillsUSA and DECA Student Recognitions and Field Trips
items.summary: The committee recognized regional award winners in SkillsUSA and DECA competitions and approved out-of-state and overnight field trips to upcoming state and national competitions.

items.title: Medford Vocational Technical High School Update
items.summary: Vocational Director Chad Fallon provided an update on staff hiring, enrollment trends, community projects, grant-funded equipment upgrades, and facility improvements.

items.title: Report on Professional Development Day
items.summary: Dr. Bernadette Ricciardelli presented a report on the March 12 professional development workshops, which the committee accepted.

items.title: Superintendent's Entry Plan Findings
items.summary: The committee voted to table the report on the Superintendent's Entry Plan findings.

items.title: Resolutions and Executive Session
items.summary: The committee passed condolence resolutions for district staff relatives and a long-time custodian before voting to enter executive session to discuss collective bargaining matters.
